title: About
subtitle: Professional Fashion, Portrait & Corporate Photographer in Paris
intro: Laurent X. Dubois is a professional photographer based in Paris, specializing in fashion photography, Paris Fashion Week coverage, editorial & executive portraits, and commercial event photography.
bio: With over 15 years of experience in the fashion and visual industry, Laurent regularly collaborates with prestigious brands, modeling agencies, and international corporations. His artistic approach combines technical precision, editorial sensitivity, and natural mastery of light and subjects.
specialties: Fashion Photography & Paris Fashion Week Backstage
Executive & Corporate Portraits (LinkedIn / Press / Annual Reports)
Editorials & Lookbooks for designers and brands
